question: What intellectual power does mastery of this mantra confer in the world?
premises: A transformative state arises in the world
The practitioner confronts debaters and doctrines
The practitioner destroys the dualist doctrine
inference: Mastery of the mantra makes one a destroyer of the dualist doctrine among debaters in the world.
plain_english: In the world, one becomes a destroyer of the dualist doctrine of debaters.
